Priya: Quick note — onboarding sample app hit a parity bug. Python SDK missing admin.rate_limits endpoint and the field names differ from REST, causing UI confusion.
Dan: Which method did you call?
Priya: `client.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id='org_sep')` -> AttributeError. curl GET /v1/admin/rate-limits?org_id=org_sep returns {"limits": [...], "window_seconds": 60}.
Luis: Oh no. Our models map `window_seconds` -> `window` which breaks the sample-app that expects the server key.
Mei: Also observed retry behavior mismatch: REST returns 429 + Retry-After but SDK JustRetries and raises RetryError without exposing Retry-After header. We need SDK to surface that so callers can respect server backoff.
Priya: Minimal repro pasted:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=TOKEN)
# fails with AttributeError
c.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id='org_sep')
```
Logs: `RetryError: backoff exhausted (cause=429) -- headers:{"retry-after":"14"}` but exception object has no `retry_after` attr.
Dan: Two actions: regen python SDK to include admin routes; update model generator to preserve server keys (or JSON aliases); and patch RetryPolicy to parse Retry-After and attach to exception.
Luis: I'll add a small compatibility layer in sample-app to accept both `window` and `window_seconds` until SDK fix lands.
Mei: I'll open a unit test simulating 429 with Retry-After and assert SDK exposes it, and run the TypeScript SDK parity check as well.
infra-bot: Issue created DEVEX-4127 "py-sdk: admin.rate_limits missing, window_seconds->window drift, retry-after not exposed" assigned to @Luis. https://redwood.internal/DEVEX-4127
Priya: Thanks — can you add a short migration note and include release instructions for Dedicated customers who pin SDK versions?
Luis: Will do. ETA EOD. I'll ping #release-war-room when PR merges. :thumbsup:
